_comment: Single source of truth for crawler-facing SEO. Consumed by scripts/generate-sitemap.js (writes public/sitemap.xml + public/robots.txt), vite-plugin-seo.js (canonical + og:url + JSON-LD), and scripts/prerender-seo.js (route-specific HTML metadata snapshots). Public page titles and descriptions are shared with the React useSeo hook. Override `siteUrl` per environment with SITE_URL, or leave it unset — the build resolvers fall back to Render's RENDER_EXTERNAL_URL before this file.
_siteUrlWarning: Resolve order (both consumers, identical): SITE_URL -> VITE_SITE_URL -> RENDER_EXTERNAL_URL / RENDER_EXTERNAL_HOSTNAME -> `siteUrl` below. `siteUrl` is the LAST resort, so it must be the REAL deployed origin, never localhost: a forgotten SITE_URL used to publish a sitemap full of http://localhost:5173 URLs and a canonical pointing off-site. When the service is renamed/moved, update `siteUrl` here AND the fallback in .github/workflows/keep-alive.yml AND the URLs in docs/.
_routesComment: Public, crawlable routes ONLY. Authenticated areas (/admin/*, /portal, /login, /dashboard) must never be listed — see the Disallow rules generated into robots.txt.
